# mypy.stubtest allowlist. The native module's stub is generated by nanobind
# from the bindings; at runtime nanobind functions and constructors expose no
# inspectable signature, and its classes use nanobind's metaclass, so stubtest
# cannot compare them. Everything else in the package is checked.
cudaq_pulse\._native\._cudaq_pulse_native\.(JITModule|MLIRPipeline|PulseModule|PulseModuleBuilder)
cudaq_pulse\._native\._cudaq_pulse_native\.(JITModule|PulseModule)\.__init__
cudaq_pulse\._native\._cudaq_pulse_native\.(build_stamp|decoder_enqueue|decoder_get|decoder_reset|evaluate_callback|freeze_type|identity_keys|infer_list_lengths|sample_envelope|shared_context_budget|shared_context_stats|verifies_everything)
# PEP 695 generic classes carry __type_params__ at runtime, which stubtest
# looks for in the stub even when the stub is the same source.
cudaq_pulse\.kernel\._kernel\.(CompiledKernel|Kernel)\.__type_params__
cudaq_pulse\.classical\.(Answer|ClassicalFunction|Pending)\.__type_params__
# Type checkers see pulse.Bits as list[int]; at runtime it is a list subclass
# that marks the items as bits.
cudaq_pulse\.classical\.Bits
# Type checkers see an lru_cache function's parameters as (*args, **kwargs).
cudaq_pulse\._waits\._computed
# QuantumSystem reads these from its description (QuantumSystem.__getattr__).
cudaq_pulse(\._device)?\.QuantumSystem\.(physical_qudits|true_qudits|parameter_drift|parameter_drift_time|advance|couplings|residual_zz|model|attribution|anharmonicities|t1_times|t2_times|t2_echo_times|thermal_populations|coupling_map|connectivity_graph|drive_amplitude_scale)
# A component reads its fields through _Field descriptors (quantum_systems.base),
# ints with a __get__, which stubtest accepts as a property only where an int
# fits the property's type, as a float; these fields are strings and tuples.
cudaq_pulse\.quantum_systems\.tuning\.(FluxTuning\.source|ChargeCoupling\.(tunings|source)|ExchangeControl\.(unit|amplitudes|exchange_hz|source))
# Tuning declares for type checkers the methods each tuning (FluxTuning) defines.
cudaq_pulse\.quantum_systems\.tuning\.Tuning\.(frequency_at|anharmonicity_at|amplitude_for)
cudaq_pulse\.quantum_systems\.tuning\.(CouplingControl|CouplingInteraction)\.at
cudaq_pulse\.quantum_systems\.tuning\.(FluxTuning|ExchangeControl)\.response
# QuantumSystem answers these through __getattr__ (quantum_systems.components.answer).
cudaq_pulse(\._device)?\.QuantumSystem\.(tuning|control|interaction)
